schema:
CREATE TABLE "rate_cards" ("item_id" INTEGER UNIQUE, "valid_from" DATE, "valid_to" DATE, "unit_rate" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id", "valid_from", "valid_to"), CHECK ("unit_rate" > 0));

CREATE TABLE "shipments" ("item_id" INTEGER, "ship_date" DATE, "qty" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY ("item_id") REFERENCES "rate_cards" ("item_id"), CHECK ("qty" > 0));
correct_query: SELECT r.item_id, SUM(s.qty * r.unit_rate) AS total_cost FROM rate_cards AS r JOIN shipments AS s ON (r.item_id = s.item_id AND s.ship_date BETWEEN r.valid_from AND r.valid_to) GROUP BY r.item_id
